intro: In this week's intelligence digest, we explore significant developments impacting the retail and luxury sectors, particularly the integration of AI technologies. Key insights include Walmart's findings on consumer behavior influenced by AI, the implications of the Supreme Court's recent tariff decisions on the jewelry industry, and Amazon's historic revenue milestone surpassing Walmart. Additionally, we highlight innovative approaches in logistics and design that are reshaping brand strategies in a competitive landscape.

readOneThing.title: Walmart says AI users build 35% bigger baskets than others

items.title: Walmart says AI users build 35% bigger baskets than others
bullets: Walmart's Sparky AI-powered shopping assistant leads to a 35% increase in order value for users compared to non-users.
Approximately half of Walmart's app users have engaged with Sparky since its launch in June 2025.
Walmart plans to expand Sparky's capabilities globally while enhancing its technology platforms for consistent retail experiences.

items.title: Supreme Court Kills IEEPA Tariffs — Here’s What It Means for Your Jewelry Business
bullets: The Supreme Court ruled 6-3 that the International Emergency Economic Powers Act does not authorize the President to impose tariffs.
This ruling specifically invalidates tariffs imposed under IEEPA, while other tariffs under different statutes remain unaffected.
The decision was published on February 20, 2026, and is considered a significant shift in U.S. tariff law.
items.summary:
AI-Generated Summary:
The Supreme Court's 6-3 ruling on IEEPA tariffs has significant implications for the jewelry business, prompting changes in the tariff landscape overnight. However, businesses are advised not to cancel supplier orders immediately.

items.title: Govt plans to create 'complete AI stack' to power innovation: Jayant Chaudhary
bullets: Union Minister Jayant Chaudhary announced plans to create a complete AI stack utilizing anonymised datasets for researchers and startups.
India's AI compute capacity has surpassed 38,000 GPUs, with projections to exceed 100,000 by the end of the year.
Chaudhary emphasized the importance of public-private partnerships in advancing AI, particularly in educational institutions for research collaboration.

AI-Generated Summary:

items.title: Exclusive: Amouage Revenue Surged 66% in 2025
bullets: Amouage achieved record global retail sales exceeding $430 million in 2025, marking a 66 percent revenue growth from the previous year.
The brand's Exceptional Extraits collection, priced around $550, accounted for over 25 percent of total sales in 2025.
In 2025, Amouage opened 13 standalone stores, increasing its total to 25 locations worldwide, with significant growth in travel retail.
items.summary:
AI-Generated Summary:
Amouage experienced a 66% revenue increase in 2025, attributed to the success of its 'Exceptional Extraits' collection and global retail presence.

items.title: Amazon surpasses Walmart in annual revenue for the first time
bullets: Amazon reported $716.9 billion in revenue for 2025, surpassing Walmart's $713.2 billion for the same period.
Amazon's advertising revenue reached over $68 billion last year, significantly outpacing Walmart's $6.4 billion in ad sales.
Walmart has held the top position on the Fortune 500 list for 13 consecutive years until this milestone by Amazon.
items.summary:
AI-Generated Summary:
Amazon has surpassed Walmart in annual revenue for the first time, marking a significant milestone in the ecommerce and retail tech industry.

items.title: What is Sarvam AI’s Indus: India’s answer to ChatGPT, Gemini-like chatbots?
bullets: Sarvam.AI has launched Indus, a new chatbot designed to compete with OpenAI's ChatGPT and Google's Gemini.
The chatbot is built on a 105 billion sovereign model and has already garnered over 10,000 downloads on Google Playstore.
Indus is currently in limited beta testing, with users experiencing a waitlist due to the startup's limited compute capacity.
items.summary:
AI-Generated Summary:
Sarvam.AI has introduced Indus, a chatbot based on its 105 billion sovereign model, to compete with global AI giants like ChatGPT and Gemini. The focus is on accuracy and relevance for the Indian market.

items.title: A Colorado Jeweler Built Her Store With Reclaimed Wood, Liquid-Metal Floors, and a 10,500-Piece Chandelier
bullets: Jennifer Farnes built Revolution Jewelry Works in Colorado Springs, incorporating reclaimed wood and liquid-metal floors into her design.
The store features a stunning 10,500-piece chandelier that took Farnes and two professionals 120 hours to assemble and hang.
Farnes utilized her extensive construction experience to design and construct the store, which reflects her childhood memories of working with her father.

items.title: Designing a Smarter Logistics Network: The Hidden Growth Lever Most New Brands Overlook
bullets: Emerging retail brands are increasingly recognizing logistics as a strategic growth lever rather than merely a cost center.
According to ATRI, empty miles accounted for 16.7% of all truck miles in the U.S. in 2024, resulting in nearly $30 billion in wasted costs.
But as margins tighten, customer expectations rise and omnichannel complexity accelerates, the brands that succeed treat logistics not as a back-office expense but as a strategic growth lever

AI-Generated Summary:
Successful retail brands are shifting their perspective on logistics from a cost center to a strategic growth lever, as margins tighten, customer expectations rise, and omnichannel complexity increases.
